message.content:
Below is a quick‑look list of the long‑weekend holidays that Canadians can take advantage of in **2023**.  
(“Long weekend” means the holiday falls on a Friday or Monday, or the holiday is observed on a Monday when it lands on a weekend.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Province(s) | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------------|-------|
| **Jan 1 – 3** | New Year’s Day (observed Mon 2) | All | New Year’s Day falls on Sunday; the observed holiday is Monday, giving a 3‑day break. |
| **Feb 20 – 22** | Family Day (3rd Monday in Feb) | Ontario, British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba | Creates a long weekend in these provinces. |
| **Apr 7 – 9** | Good Friday | All | Good Friday is a federal holiday on Friday. |
| **May 20 – 22** | Victoria Day (Mon 22) | All | Victoria Day is always on the last Monday in May. |
| **Jul 1 – 3** | Canada Day (observed Mon 3) | All | Canada Day falls on Saturday; the observed holiday is Monday. |
| **Sep 2 – 4** | Labour Day (Mon 4) | All | Labour Day is always on the first Monday in September. |
| **Oct 7 – 9** | Thanksgiving (Mon 9) | All | Thanksgiving is always on the second Monday in October. |
| **Nov 11 – 13** | Remembrance Day (observed Mon 13) | All | Remembrance Day falls on Saturday; the observed holiday is Monday. |
| **Dec 23 – 25** | Christmas (Mon 25) | All | Christmas is always on a Monday in 2023. |

### Quick‑reference checklist

- **New Year’s Day** – Jan 1 (observed Jan 2)  
- **Family Day** – Feb 20 (in Ontario, BC, AB, SK, MB)  
- **Good Friday** – Apr 7  
- **Victoria Day** – May 22  
- **Canada Day** – Jul 1 (observed Jul 3)  
- **Labour Day** – Sep 4  
- **Thanksgiving** – Oct 9  
- **Remembrance Day** – Nov 11 (observed Nov 13)  
- **Christmas** – Dec 25  

These are the federal holidays that create long weekends in 2023. If you’re targeting a specific province, you may want to add any additional provincial holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday (e.g., “St. Patrick’s Day” in Newfoundland & Labrador is on a Wednesday, so it does **not** create a long weekend).
